SCHOOL STATEMENT
STATEMENT of Indian Day Schools in the Dominion (from which returns have been received) for the Fiscal Year ending
March 31, 1920
NOTE. - The "Standard" indicates the classification of the pupils according to the reading-book used and therefore shows the degree
of general advancement in all the studies prescribed by the curriculum, thus. -

Standard I First Reader, Part I.
Standard II First Reader, Part II.
Standard III Second Reader.
Standard IV Third Reader.
Standard V Fourth Reader.
Standard VI Fifth Reader.
